hero_subtitle: The Optics Group studies light-matter and quantum systems: from liquid crystals and polarimetric imaging to ultracold atoms and topological photonics.

research_lines.title: Classical optics
research_lines.description: Polarimetry, liquid-crystal devices, diffractive optics and structured light, with applications in biomedical imaging and metrology.

research_lines.title: Quantum optics & photonics
research_lines.description: Ultracold atoms in optical lattices, topological photonics, quantum thermodynamics and quantum simulation of gauge theories.
